notes.title: The Hirdmen of Sudrvik: Classes & Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
[p]The Hirdmen of Sudrvik: Classes & Abilities in NORSE: Oath of Blood

As detailed in our recent Steam Community post, [i]Building a Viking Settlement[/i], constructing the thriving village of Sudrvik is central to [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i]. But a settlement is only as strong as its warriors. This week, we’re charging into the fray to introduce the fierce hirdmen who fight under your command.[/p][p]In this overview, we unveil the classes and abilities that shape your warband. Each hirdman uses a distinct fighting style and two paths to mastery, letting you train warriors who will help you dominate the battlefield. forged to your vision. As they grow in power, your hirdmen earn skill points to draw from either path, offering unique ways to hone their prowess for the fights ahead. [/p][p]These are the heroes who will carve your legend in blood and glory.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Berserkr[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/c3f0df594a6a4b249e1a277267d221157a2b295c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Brandishing dual axes or swords, the Berserkr is a whirlwind of steel, charging into battle with reckless abandon. With their [b]Leap[/b] ability, they vault over obstacles or enemies to shatter formations, untouched by Opportunity Attacks. Whether driven by primal rage or the spirit of the gods, Berserkers are unstoppable vanguards.[/p][list][*][p][b]Bear[/b]: Warriors that bring these skills draw strength from each kill, growing tougher with every foe felled, perfect for enduring the longest battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wolf[/b]: Swift and deadly, Wolf skills are about precision, avoiding Opportunity Attacks and leaving enemies bleeding and broken in their wake.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/6c3f03fd0c2c81ce4c359397fae4367bb7e4e5dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Rekkr[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/45393ea5f56ec57b5ac37f0f0a751c58ce944b7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Wielding massive two-handed axes, Rekkr are the embodiment of raw power, wading into the fray to crush all in their path. Their [b]Hew[/b] ability cleaves through up to three foes with devastating force. Their war cries echo as a warning to any who dare challenge the settlement.[/p][list][*][p][b]Champion[/b]: Masters of control, Champions cripple enemies with debuffs like Prone, redirect enemy attacks, and bolster their own defenses to hold the line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slayer[/b]: Relentless destroyers, Slayers unleash area attacks, enrage foes to draw their focus, and use their skills to guarantee execution of enemies to refresh their Action Points for unending carnage.[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/3e08e3edd8a8fd20c337381178b04926057955cb.jpg"][/img][/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Drengr[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/dacaa32813b85ca939046bb6624c75a0063f1cb4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Armed with a sword or axe in one hand and a sturdy shield in the other, Drengr are the stalwart protectors of the warband, mastering battlefield control. Their [b]Shield Slam[/b] hurls enemies into hazards or allies, triggering Opportunity Attacks that turn defense into offense. [/p][list][*][p][b]Warrior[/b]: Experts in tactical disruption, Warriors use knockbacks to trigger Opportunity Attacks to dominate positioning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Protector[/b]: Selfless guardians, Protectors draw enemy attention and shrug off blows to keep their allies safe.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/a3231a3d0ac8ba906de6ed5b7d390258428e289b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Hersir[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/c3ebc1aa490cc6e3c0cc9ddf8cc39a72e003292c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gripping long spears, the Hersir can strike from two tiles away, piercing through foes and bolstering nearby allies with buffs to inspire extra attacks. They weave teamwork and precision into every thrust, ensuring no warrior fights alone.[/p][list][*][p][b]Warchief[/b]: Leaders who debilitate foes and rally allies with coordinated strikes of extra attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skald[/b]: Bards of battle, Skalds lift allies’ spirits, buffing allies, and debuffing enemies to tip the scales of war.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/34a4b92ce619199038bc44757fa3d603a38abff7.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Bogmathr[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/53213613bdbf5458c3ec9b3b4469e5cfe0087d1c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Aiming their bows with deadly precision, Bogmathr command the battlefield from afar, striking with pinpoint accuracy or devastating volleys. Their [b]Lay Low[/b] ability lets them slip away, avoid targeting, and pin foes with immobilizing shots or bleeds. [/p][list][*][p][b]Hunter[/b]: Masters of attrition, Hunters pin enemies and inflict bleeds to weaken them over time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Marksman[/b]: Lethal snipers, Marksmen pierce armor and enemies, land critical hits, and deliver heavy hits that can reset its cooldown for relentless barrages.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/08e63b5b3775cbc408542e6eba2732acf39b05ac.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Forge Your Saga![/b][/h2][p]Which warrior will lead your warband to glory? Are you drawn to the Berserkr’s fury, or the Drengr’s unbreakable resolve? Share your favorite class builds and strategies in the comments below and let us hear how you’re shaping Sudrvik’s legend![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/0d62a3a5e8e249ae37f7afe45ec75d0dba274671.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Wishlist Now[/b][/h2][p]Haven’t added [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] to your Steam Wishlist yet? Join the battle and wishlist it now on the Steam Store![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/c273b76192b4b385a5b744de04bade5fe264c4f5.gif"][/img][/p]

Originally premiered at the Future Game Show Gamescom Showcase![/p][p][/p][h3]WISHLIST TODAY: [/h3][p][url="https://www.norsethegame.com/"]https://www.norsethegame.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/joypixels/assets/8.0/png/unicode/64/2694.png"][/img]Join the NORSE Community[img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/joypixels/assets/8.0/png/unicode/64/2694.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/norse"]https://discord.gg/norse[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/norsethegame"]https://x.com/norsethegame[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/norsegame.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/norsegame.bsky.social[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/norsethegame/"]https://www.instagram.com/norsethegame/[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@norse.game?lang=en"]https://www.tiktok.com/@norse.game?lang=en[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]About NORSE: Oath of Blood [/h3][p]Step into the rugged, untamed beauty of dark age Norway in NORSE: Oath of Blood, a turn-based tactics game that plunges players into the heart of the Viking Age. Embark on an epic quest for vengeance as Gunnar, a young warrior whose destiny is forged in blood and betrayal. After the treacherous Steinarr Far-Spear murders his father, Jarl Gripr, and usurps his high seat, Gunnar's path is clear: rebuild, ally, and rise to reclaim honor and justice.[/p][p][/p][p]Craft a settlement from the ground up, gather allies from far and wide, and train a formidable warband to stand by his side. Every decision shapes the world around Gunnar, as he navigates a landscape teeming with both danger and opportunity. Face off against rival clans, forge unbreakable bonds, and outmaneuver his enemies in tactical, turn-based battles that test players' strategic prowess.[/p]

notes.title: Bloodlines & Betrayal - Part Two
notes.notes:
[p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510710285788516540"]In Part One of this series[/url], we introduced three key characters from [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i]. Today, we turn to three more figures whose choices helped shape the origin of this brutal and vengeful saga.[/p][p][/p][h1]Bloodlines & Betrayal - Part Two [/h1][p]Where heroes rise, tyrants often stand in their way. This is the clash of ambition and legacy that fuels the coming storm.[/p][p][/p][h2]Jarl Grípr[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfP1JMp1Eg5_AbHwv5P3nE_HMD8fZzY2FFm0HydmMjkJb2DsOQBpayBKW8VaM_52d_lQIzNIjG9Kw_FsNWp6_5I0RF9bDG_yJerP_5aLOTsztDkZcZmEnAN4cB1Di_u-_qIS9ZN?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]Once a fierce raider, Grípr chose a different path focused on peace, prosperity, and trade. As Jarl of Borre, he was beloved by his people but judged by some as weak. That judgment proved fatal.[/p][p][/p][p]His death at the hands of his most trusted warrior sets in motion the bloody saga of [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i]. His children now carry the weight of his legacy.
[/p][h2]Ragnhildr[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXebHjOeKpeXQcMGuHsqIRmLCYhOeeIa82k27s43pdn2YA2NlE59THQWnScJtz3E7YHXBtfoXYeyY64IiupA-MGVS_cqx-Bi1iHVw2X4Nl3F8AZM-IETXKyXLLXEaEKu-Vfuz5rtRQ?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]Ragnhildr, wife of Jarl Grípr and mother to Gunnar and Sigrid, is a woman of fierce resolve and quiet strength. When her husband is betrayed and slain, she does not falter, instead orchestrating her children’s escape and commanding Arn to protect them at all costs. [/p][p][/p][p]Her sacrifice ensures the twins live to fight another day, even as her own fate remains unknown. In every battle they face, Gunnar and Sigrid carry the fire of their mother’s will.[/p][p][/p][h2]Steinarr Far-Spear[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdivhyIHn2OTMReibWcP1479VHFesctMnVqpaHSfIJ7STrFQnHAOJ_tH_P1RPZowLS9xhu6ugwkKxz9T7NTWsZBZPDnJ3GiihnqIoSPnrJR2jmz1AGr_Ib16ZKl-lErJmYYsdUdVg?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]Once the Jarl’s champion, Steinarr grew bitter under Grípr’s peaceful rule. Craving conquest and power, he plunged his spear into the heart of loyalty, murdering Grípr and seizing Borre for himself.[/p][p][/p][p]Now a self-made tyrant, Steinarr rules through fear and force. His betrayal is the flame that ignites Gunnar’s quest and marks the first act in a storm of vengeance that will engulf them all.[/p][p][/p][h1]Wishlist Now[/h1][p]To see more about [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], check out the latest Story Teaser Trailer released during IGN Live.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="V24xJDzxxiU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]For a deeper look into the game, watch the IGN Rewind Theater interview featuring [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] developers Terje Lundberg (Creative Director) and Philip Stevens (Narrative Director).[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TQQsL0qIaaU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, be sure to wishlist [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/"]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/"] on the Steam Store[/url][/u] now. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXftl-J6kRXoTI4lEhOIUTJPvBM4nWuadTQTTpAyBnGNuKySM4pTUiT0N_bGMHdNX7PsoesSsju0LIrjocSilOz2FwRWQZZ4C6zJ1qrlZDCS_RowHWhUPtlCUxI7v-R8vzRsGaHnwg?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Bloodlines & Betrayal - Part One
notes.notes:
[p]Last week we talked about the various artisans that will be helping you build your village in [b]The Viking Artisans of Sudrvik[/b] - [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510710285788512761"][u]Part One[/u][/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510710285788515599"][u]Part Two[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][p]This week we are introducing to you some of [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i]’s main characters in this two part series - [b]Bloodlines and Betrayal.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Bloodlines & Betrayal - Part One[/h1][p]Every saga is born of fire, a single flame that catches and consumes. In [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], that fire is betrayal. From the ashes of treachery rises a tale of ambition, honor, and vengeance. These are the warriors at the heart of it all.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gunnar Grípsson[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcf089ATNNxc25hjYLAWQ3jbAw6MMnjJSMx7JzBTky-kvixMaTC-meMcSsRqUBmWFhZtjeeYGk38kSlJQFDWGr-lS_pkXQpAPESWuzoKetCncUeHK6VwGXgX4zeecOQAGW-U4twtw?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]The son of Jarl Grípr, Gunnar is charismatic, headstrong, and born to lead. When his father is cut down by the very man sworn to protect him, Gunnar escapes with only his sister, Sigrid, and Arn Spear-Breaker at his side.[/p][p][/p][p]Gifted land, a boat, and a small crew by his uncle, Jarl Egil, Gunnar must carve out a new life, earning sword-fame with every enemy faced, with every battle won. Only with a thriving settlement and a warband at his back will he stand a chance of taking his revenge and reclaiming his birthright.[/p][p][/p][h2]Sigrid Grípsdóttir[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe6I9dfdq7z4DH4LZCDb9vZOboWniTxIybG18RtoFwyuTfKyGzyCOHHjzIVhAfbCBLknGJfTy7un2DEY4-cTCCtBR0p8O7kSmlg0H9r4C0LYcAX_2xTBdeIRy5UpjZHyriG6HpS?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]Gunnar’s twin, Sigrid, is iron-willed and sharp-tongued. More at home with a spear than a spindle, her parents gave up trying to tame her long ago. A jarl’s daughter is meant to marry for alliance, but Sigrid won’t be bartered like silver. [/p][p][/p][p]She’s no man’s prize, and a match for any warrior who dares face her.[/p][p][/p][h2]Arn Shield-Breaker[/h2][h2][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd5Q-ZhpTbALEu2o_ZAfKIeqlpVwjpuIrM7GVU14FRy6aDWbEgnfljW9GrjH6dQgbt26lXxFlHbfadDBIIzkJqV7PzdSHvFwVtQsAfJqSRMjobQm0KG9Dot6h1Bwv1omaTI7Ih2?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/h2][p]Once the personal bodyguard of Gunnar and Sigrid’s mother, Ragnihldr, Arn is a seasoned warrior and sharp-minded tactician. When betrayal tears their world apart, it is Arn who leads the twins to safety.[/p][p] [/p][p]Fiercely loyal, he serves as mentor and shield, standing beside them as their strength—and their enemies—grow.[/p][p][/p][h1]Stay Tuned for Part Two [/h1][p]These three are the core of a rising storm. They have lost everything — and now they will rise together to take it back. [/p][p][/p][p]Let us know which of these warriors you’re most eager to follow into battle![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for[b] Part Two of Bloodlines & Betrayal[/b]. [/p][p]If you haven’t already, be sure to wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/"][u][i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i][/u][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/"][u] on the Steam Store[/u][/url] now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXftl-J6kRXoTI4lEhOIUTJPvBM4nWuadTQTTpAyBnGNuKySM4pTUiT0N_bGMHdNX7PsoesSsju0LIrjocSilOz2FwRWQZZ4C6zJ1qrlZDCS_RowHWhUPtlCUxI7v-R8vzRsGaHnwg?key=gutaRLIr6lc-jde0a_VOew"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Viking Artisans of Sudrvik - Part Two
notes.notes:
[p][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510710285788512761"]In Part One of this series[/url][/u], we met the blacksmith, the farmer, and the seamstress—three vital figures who shape daily life in Suthrvik with their skill, spirit, and stories. 
[/p][p]Now, in Part Two, we turn our attention to more of the unsung heroes who keep your Viking settlement thriving. From woodcarvers to fishermen and hunters, these characters may not lead charges into battle, but their contributions are just as crucial to the survival and soul of Sudrvik.[/p][p][/p][h1]Olaf - Woodcarver[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd-tfriq4MyUZ7XP6yXKrqVc_PiIyaIN9rd8NmAzaYdse-uRNyktPrsgSsV4rVGPHFQQgRgvRXGBZNZ-cNBN2-0oOwu8qhUPFxhBnpDJoUiKSaM1oQjVpQOMd8LFeSoiwBPN5R8og?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Wood carver, skald, and self-declared great lover, Olaf is as fond of his own voice as he is of a strong drink and a warm audience. With a harp on his hip and a carving knife in his belt, he crafts both tales and timber with equal flair.[/p][p][/p][p]Though often mocked for his vanity and endless verses, Olaf understands the power of story. Kings rise and fall, but a skald’s song endures. He sees in Gunnar the shape of legend and intends to be the one to carve it in wood and word alike.
[/p][p]Loud, lewd, and loyal in his own theatrical way, Olaf brings mirth and myth to the fire. If Gunnar Gripsson is to carve himself a fine reputation as a warrior and leader, if he is to have his tale told around the hearths of the Norse lands, it will be Olaf who gives that tale rhythm and rhyme.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gertrud - Fisherwoman[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeQE9Z0YPjGSIOq_ch_UMUMzIHU9hiaREj5OMwbOYBeHfYJfXKdxFsZ8Y984BTeYjW5WtZPwPsncZ2_otbceeyszs0hpwctSYNRs_tuZhz9fKrpsylrxXrRW4IEnTJdmTvHQ4d-4A?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p]Brash, foul-mouthed, and utterly unbothered by rank or reputation, Gertrud is one of the finest fisherfolk in the region and she knows it. She sails the fjords with a sure hand, sharp tongue, and a deep knowledge of every hidden shoal and secret fishing spot the coast can offer.[/p][p][/p][p]She has little patience for fools, and even less for men who think themselves clever. Most find her crude and caustic; fewer notice the quiet care beneath the bluster. Whether hauling nets, cursing the weather, or muttering wisdom between spits over the side of her boat, Gertrud is a fixture of Sudrvik, gruff, loyal, and unshakably real.[/p][p][/p][h1]Hallbjorn - The Huntsman[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf0r8zG_Jc74dRhHK5lYiw1QQu1j-AU5WBQAwSWARRUWVdfifHmBuGX5j99tCHMJks-TocYW1C6bN8tGC9IOcqn1ZnP7KpEfV_X_cs2fxByVoE8Je6_N1qDrddj21W1I46z3jj94A?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p]A solitary figure of the wilds, Hallbjorn is a tracker and hunter of rare skill. Gruff, guarded, and slow to trust, he prefers the company of trees and beasts to that of men. His eyes miss nothing, and his instincts are sharper than any blade.[/p][p][/p][p]Hardened by years of survival in the harshest reaches of the land, Hallbjorn knows how to find what others cannot, and how to kill it if needed. Not one for conversation, his presence commands respect. In the growing village, he is both scout and shadow, a man of the old ways, in tune with the rhythm of the earth and the whisper of the wind.
[/p][h1]June News Recap[/h1][p][/p][p]Here are a few bits of news from the month of June that you may have missed:[/p][p][/p][h2]Building a Viking Settlement[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeB8MgNlq2loTemTk2gQeM0__QJZqPWjyTMYkK775Fzq5Ir_yGd0jxOvbM1-dPzMPH8bcq1220urY0BVmcvm1ue1SaxCo1cF8WfKlcNPFNQGqlYoxHH9rpduhRWd0yOzIkcb-ft?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], you begin with little more than courage, scavenge timber, iron, and other resources to build and expand your settlement, recruit hardened hirdmen, craft legendary gear with master artisans, and forge vital trade alliances as you lead your warband on a brutal saga of vengeance and honor.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510709651799540025"]Click here to check out the Steam Community post, Building a Viking Settlement[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]IGN Live Rewind Theater[/h2][p][/p][p]Terje Lundberg (Creative Director) and Philip Stevens (Narrative Director) join IGN’s Alan Knight for an in-depth discussion about NORSE: Oath of Blood. notes.title: The Viking Artisans of Sudrvik - Part One
notes.notes:
[p]Constructing the settlement of Suthrvik plays a key role in [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], as detailed in last week’s Steam Community post, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3054690/view/510709651799540025"][u]Building a Viking Settlement[/u][/url].  [/p][p]This week, we want to take a closer look and introduce you to the skilled craftspeople of Sudrvik.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeAI5-Ui0i3GCyUOnRwwGQTTN8HwDyy_NpfFoCqxMzbSrRWtOA-lfZfRFfnOiCVgcSkY57Lfitex-vooHEd6zL3srtWOeG0mhZc3G0m8XzrIRdL4Q4g4yLxvpVBbwbQk-80HSYwTw?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img] [/p][p]In this two-part series, we’ll highlight the artisans and craftspeople who bring the Viking settlement of Sudrvik to life. [/p][p]These workers are essential, not only for the village’s survival and growth, but also for outfitting your warband for the battles ahead. Sudrvik thrives not just on the strength of its warriors, but on the vibrant personalities who labor behind the scenes to keep the heart of the settlement beating.[/p][p][/p][h1]Torsten – The Blacksmith[/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeJV7sAr7xNT7Ovfrj-VItaV3m4vxhna2N6Bp-PxKAPQu9YMQR4dCZ3CzRFMIgIcU-iKQUtG7UOUw53nDb28vhq1qvBUUnbzkVOGW1WkMc5mbk3K0Nx0VQnLRauL3euWai0oTLyrw?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img] [/p][p]A wandering blacksmith who settles in Sudrvik, Torsten quickly becomes an indispensable part of the village. His masterful forging of weapons and armor strengthens the warriors who fight under Gunnar’s banner.[/p][p]Torsten brings humor, heart, and a touch of chaos wherever he goes. He’s as quick with a joke as he is with a hammer, and never says no to a strong drink or a louder song. Nevertheless, the emotional wound of his brother’s betrayal and their father’s death has never healed, and Torsten is known to fall into dark moods and mires of self pity.[/p][p][/p][h1]Holti – The Farmer[/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc9UcGmxwLmQnSrYwNaK8NO2A2GDqSvSfmGgefqWpgP1KLxwNNZLEArAH7lfbvlt1p_2iInei9mc-yXcSMQ6vR4NjsfgZhAndzPO1BuGKQkTTOTvl1cVaKY45G7F4CMBpMavu4Ccg?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Nervous, meticulous, and very much under the thumb of his formidable wife Geirlaug, Holti is no Warrior, but he is vital. Responsible for Sudrvik’s farms, stores, and harvests, he ensures the settlement not only survives, but grows.[/p][p]Though often flustered and henpecked, Holti’s tireless work anchors the village’s economy and daily life. In a world of blood and steel, he brings a touch of warmth, routine, and reluctant humor to the saga.[/p][p][/p][h1]Geirlaug - The Seamstress[/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfmUuHW6GLnn7C1IxIAm8gsFCVGybzU7xgg2-8cCupQLo8UI2fKCz-XlXP3K2iag971vUlieq63idvT23Q48ZXz5YKznMs0rSmJMw-_0iIpnA7vGnJDqOg5PnFxZ07072PKw9zWYQ?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A gifted seamstress with a sharp tongue and a sharper eye, Geirlaug runs her household—and her husband Holti—with iron certainty wrapped in silken charm. Known for her flirtatious manner and commanding presence, she weaves gossip as deftly as she weaves cloth.[/p][p]Geirlaug plays a quiet but crucial role in Sudrvik’s life: outfitting warriors, clothing children, and keeping spirits high with her wit and confidence. While Holti frets, she flirts, schemes, and sews, always two steps ahead of everyone else.[/p][p][/p][h1]Look Out for Part Two![/h1][p]Stay tuned for Part Two of this series, where we’ll delve further into the characters of [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] and the crafts folk who bring the Viking settlement of Sudrvik to life.[/p][p][/p][h2]Story Teaser Trailer[/h2][p]To see more about [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], check out the latest [b]Story Teaser Trailer[/b] released during IGN Live.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="V24xJDzxxiU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Interview with the Developers[/h2][p]For a deeper look into the game, watch the IGN Rewind Theater interview featuring [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] developers [b]Terje Lundberg[/b] (Creative Director) and [b]Philip Stevens[/b] (Narrative Director).[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TQQsL0qIaaU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Wishlist Now[/h2][p]If you haven’t already, be sure to wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/"][u]NORSE: Oath of Blood on the Steam Store[/u][/url] now.
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe7xZbqcRbga9TfDkrUft2gyQKu1E6_ClKpe02qZEgc2Ru-znu_3z15CqV8y58EL0WkYnQrN6bcInfxRCuh4dodmUlGZqcYK1yjjBWxBj80BRMGB2TLQb40pPvIAA1jwMcIcvxG2Q?key=sZW3H5JrVhk6TpwESrnylg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Celebrating International Viking Day!
notes.notes:
On this [b]International Viking Day[/b], we honor the legacy of the Norse with something worthy of the sagas: the unveiling of our latest trailer and a new name - [i][b]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/b][/i].

This trailer offers new peeks into the brutal violence, rich culture, and delicate diplomacy that define the Viking age in our upcoming turn-based tactical RPG. 

[previewyoutube=xGZn6jHZITg;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in the harsh, untamed wilderness of dark age Norway, [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] puts players in the war-worn boots of Gunnar, a young warrior out to avenge the murder of his father, Jarl Gripr, at the hands of the traitor Steinarr Far-Spear. As Gunnar, you must rebuild your shattered clan, gather allies, and rise to reclaim what was taken.

But survival in this world demands more than vengeance.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[list]
[*]Tactical Turn-Based Combat: Engage in brutal skirmishes where positioning and tactics are everything.

[*]Settlement Building: Raise your village from a meager camp to a fortified stronghold.

[*]Narrative-Driven Choices: Forge alliances, betray enemies, and shape Gunnar’s destiny through every decision.

[*]Authentic Viking Storytelling: Written by Giles Kristian, Sunday Times bestselling author of Norse historical fiction, the game delivers an immersive, character-driven Viking epic.
[/list]
Currently in development for Windows PC and consoles, [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] is scheduled for release in 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/44fc35e62f99b622bda0e762c1d39f8a1570309c.png[/img]

Raise a horn and join us in honoring the legacy of the Norse, the seafarers, warriors and storytellers whose sagas still echo through the fjords of history.

[b]Skål![/b]

[i]– The Arctic Hazard & Tripwire Presents Teams[/i]

notes.title: How MetaHuman and Unreal Engine 5 Are Powering NORSE: Oath of Blood
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/050525/seizeyourbirthright.gif[/img]

Greetings, warriors!

We are thrilled to share a glimpse into the development of NORSE: Oath of Blood, and how Unreal Engine 5’s cutting-edge technology, especially MetaHuman, is helping us bring our world to life.

Our goal from the very beginning was authenticity. Thanks to MetaHuman, we have been able to create deeply detailed and expressive characters. Every facial movement, every small gesture, tells part of the story we are trying to share.

Unreal Engine 5 has opened incredible possibilities for us. With Nanite, we are able to create richly detailed environments. Lumen allows us to achieve dynamic, realistic lighting that reacts naturally to the world. And MetaHuman lets us craft believable characters who truly connect with players. These tools have given our small team the ability to achieve visuals and storytelling quality that would have been impossible just a few years ago.

[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/050525/epicmegagrantsrecipientlogo.png[/img]

The team at Arctic Hazard are also grateful to have received an Epic MegaGrant, which has helped push NORSE: Oath of Blood even further than we first imagined. Working with Unreal’s latest and greatest tools has not just accelerated development; it has elevated the entire creative process for us.

We invite you to learn more about our journey in the full interview with Epic Games: [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/developer-interviews/norse-is-a-tactical-viking-game-that-taps-into-many-aspects-of-unreal-engine-5-s-ecosystem]Read it here[/url]

Below is a video interview with Arctic Hazard’s Creative Director, Terje Lundberg, who discusses how the game uses narrative to distinguish itself from others in the genre.

[previewyoutube=Z8m207DGvjU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for being part of this adventure with us.

notes.title: NORSE: Oath of Blood is Coming!
notes.notes:
[h1][b][b]NORSE: Oath of Blood is Coming[/b][/b][/h1]
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some incredible news to share with you today – [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] is officially being published by Tripwire Presents! We couldn't be more excited to finally tell you, and we want to bring you along for the ride as [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] marches toward its 2025 launch.

Check out the announcement trailer if you have not already!
[previewyoutube=D5f5X7wtoVg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b][b]Step Into Gunnar’s Saga[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/blooddemandsbloodbption2.gif[/img]

In [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i], you are Gunnar, a young warrior betrayed and cast aside by Steinarr Far-Spear, whose treachery robbed you of kin and honor alike. With blade in hand and vengeance burning in your heart, you must rise from the ashes of your shattered world, carving out a future through the mountains and fjords of Viking Age Norway.

It will not be enough merely to lead your warband into battle. You must also rebuild, gather loyal followers, forge alliances, and shape your destiny with every choice you make.

[h2][b][b]Tactical Combat, Viking-Style[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/tacticalcombat.gif[/img]

If you love deep strategy and challenging battles, you’re going to feel right at home. [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] blends classic turn-based tactics with authentic Viking culture, even incorporating "Glima," the traditional Norse martial art. Every decision you make, both on and off the battlefield, will have real consequences for Gunnar and his people.

And, because we know story matters just as much as combat, we’re thrilled to have Giles Kristian, bestselling author of the acclaimed [i]Raven[/i] and [i]Rise of Sigurd[/i] trilogies, helping craft the world and its characters. We can’t wait for you to immerse yourself in the saga he’s helped create.

[h2][b][b]Built by Veterans, For Fans Like You[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/mocapstudiocropped.png[/img]

Our team at Arctic Hazard is made up of developers who’ve worked on games like [i]Assassin’s Creed: Odyssey[/i], [i]Metro: Exodus[/i], and [i]Age of Conan[/i] – but [i]NORSE: Oath of Blood[/i] is something special. It’s a game made by fans of Viking stories and tactical games, for fans who’ve been craving a gritty, true-to-spirit Viking adventure.
